summary: get_url options for GSSAPI/Kerberos auth (no NTLM), using ~/.netrc, honoring proxies, and validating certificates.
questions: How do I download with Kerberos authentication using get_url?
How do I stop get_url using .netrc credentials?
How do I disable proxy use for one download?
How do I skip SSL validation in get_url?

answer_card.title: get_url gssapi, netrc, proxy, TLS
answer_card.answer_md:
- `use_gssapi` (false): Kerberos/Negotiate; needs python `gssapi`; creds via `url_username`/`url_password` or `KRB5CCNAME`. **NTLM not supported.**
- `use_netrc` (true)
- `use_proxy` (true)
- `validate_certs` (true)
